title: Smoked Salmon Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired stew made with smoked salmon, Egyptian spices, and hot peppers.
instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add smoked salmon, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add hot peppers, tagine spice blend, and chicken broth.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through.
Stir in rice and cook, covered, for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the rice is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
